# `@videojs/spf/engines/hls-audio-mpeg-ts`

Source: [src/playback/engines/hls-audio-mpeg-ts.ts](../../../src/playback/engines/hls-audio-mpeg-ts.ts)

## createEngine

Create an audio-only HLS playback engine that also plays MPEG-TS: `@videojs/spf/engines/hls-audio`'s engine with each
MPEG-TS audio rendition — an audio-only asset, the alternates of a video asset, or a video asset's default audio
carried in its video segments — transmuxed to fMP4 on the client. The Mux audio Media is built over it.

### External signals

The engine's features declare these state keys for code outside the engine to write; no behavior sets them. The SPF Medias write them from their own properties, and code driving an engine directly writes `engine.state.<key>.set(value)`. Each is declared with [defineExternalSignals](../core/define-external-signals.md#defineexternalsignals), which is what makes the key part of the engine's state type.

| Key | Type | From | Doc |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `userAudioTrackSelection` | `Partial<AudioTrack> \| undefined` | [audioFeature](../features/audio.md) | Consumer-driven constraint narrowing the audio candidate set. Sibling of `userVideoTrackSelection`. Partial-track shape — `{ language: 'es' }`, `{ id: 'audio-en' }`, etc. Multi-language-audio Tier 2 programmatic-write path. |
| `disableRemotePlayback` | `boolean \| undefined` | [airPlayFeature](../features/airplay.md) | Author intent for the AirPlay/remote-playback picker, written by the media adapter's `disableRemotePlayback` IDL property. `true` is an explicit opt-out: `setupAirPlay` reads it at attach and sets nothing up, leaving the element's remote playback disabled. Distinct from the underlying media element's own `disableRemotePlayback`, which stays programmatically managed (ManagedMediaSource / AirPlay). An external signal: the adapter writes it whether or not `setupAirPlay` is composed. |
